blogs.title: Unlocking the Full Potential of H100: How FlashAttention-3 Hits 75% Utilization
blogs.description: While previous versions like FlashAttention-2 left significant performance on the table (achieving only 35% utilization on H100 GPUs), this post dives into how FlashAttention-3 bridges that gap. We'll explore the concept of 'producer-consumer' asynchrony and warp-specialization, explaining how separating data movement from computation allows the GPU to run at near-maximum capacity, delivering up to a 2x speedup.

blogs.title: The Ping-Pong Effect: Overlapping Math and Softmax for Faster AI
blogs.description: In traditional attention mechanisms, the math-heavy matrix multiplications (GEMMs) often sit idle waiting for slower 'special function' calculations like softmax to finish. This blog breaks down FlashAttention-3's innovative 'ping-pong' scheduling technique. Learn how the algorithm cleverly interleaves these operations so that while one part of the GPU calculates softmax, another is already crunching numbers for the next step, effectively hiding latency and boosting throughput.

blogs.title: FP8 Precision Without the Accuracy Penalty: Solving the Outlier Problem
blogs.description: Moving to low-precision formats like FP8 promises massive speedups but historically suffers from numerical errors, especially with 'outlier' values common in Large Language Models. This post explains how FlashAttention-3 tackles this head-on using two key techniques: block quantization and incoherent processing. We'll demystify how these methods spread out extreme values to ensure that running attention in FP8 is not only twice as fast but also significantly more accurate than standard approaches.
